text: A muscular male figure, likely adult, crouches low with a spear. Skin is dark brown, hair black, shoulder-length, straight. Face is broad, jaw prominent, expression focused. Bare-chested, wears red loincloth. Kneels on one knee, right hand grips spear shaft near tip, left hand steadies it. Behind him, three other figures in similar poses hold spears. Background shows rocky terrain under twilight hues of purple and blue.
